## (2) Forms, products, and seizure findings

- **Physical form:** white solid in pure form; melting point 64–66°C; soluble up to about 25 mg/mL in ethanol, DMSO, and DMF; sparingly soluble in aqueous buffers; poorly soluble in water.
- **Forms found:** mainly herbal/plant material (smoking mixtures, including commercially branded "legal high" products); powder; to a lesser extent liquids, blotters, and unspecified forms.
- **Other formulations:** e-liquids for vaping; home-prepared e-liquids made by dissolving powder in propylene glycol.
- **Packaging:** not given, beyond the note that each packet may need powder in the order of tens of milligrams.
- **Seizures and drug checking:**
  - 0.79 g white powder seized by customs in Hungary, September 2014 (notification).
  - Single powder seizures over 1 kg reported by Belgium, Bulgaria, France, and the Netherlands.
  - Herbal material approximately 100 kg in total (74 kg reported by Turkey); powder approximately 13 kg.
  - UK reported 129 seizures (3 kg) in prisons or custodial settings, mostly herbal.
  - Largest single seizure: about 2.3 kg powder, France, 2017.
  - SPICE project: 72 of 776 herbal mixtures (9.3%), January 2015 to June 2017.
  - WEDINOS (Wales): 20 herbal mixtures and 4 powders, November 2015 to March 2017.
  - Four analysed products contained 44–120 mg/g; eight products contained 0.7–10.6% w/w.
